description: The file 'hal_logger.cpp' is a C source file implementing logging utility functions for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer). It defines functions to log messages with different severity levels, handles initialization and termination routines for logging settings based on environment variables and filesystem checks, and includes some static functions for setup/teardown. It relies on external definitions such as 'eMessageLevel' and logging macros, and accesses standard I/O for output.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified severity level, function name, line number, and formatted string. Handles message formatting and output to stdout or stderr.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes logging settings at library load time, checking for environment variables or files to determine verbose logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Logs termination message at library unload time.
